description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.
